nodes.title: STARTER — MiniMax H3 Reference to Video (T2V / I2V via keyframe)
widgets_values: Create the opening clip for a new continuous video. Establish coherent subject identity, camera, lighting, environment, motion, voice, ambience, and audiovisual timing so later masked extensions can continue seamlessly. If an H3 keyframe is enabled at frame 1, treat it as the exact opening image and animate naturally forward. Connected reference images are identity/appearance references only and should not force their pose, framing, expression, or lighting onto the shot.

Use H3 AV EXTENSION CONTROLLER to choose the start mode, number of active extensions, audio feather, and previews.

Existing Video starts from a loaded source clip. T2V generates a starter without an image keyframe. I2V / Custom Keyframes enables the starter image/keyframe group.

Set the prompts and references in the active generation groups. Reference Audio 1 and 2 are optional and bypassed by default.

Enable extensions in order and keep Active Extensions set to the number you want to use.
